explanation: "Not every hyperbolic group is residually finite." Group.IsHyperbolic is the Gromov four-point condition for the word metric of a finite generating family, which is a standard equivalent definition. The solved status rests on the OpenAI preprint (Sept 2026), which I confirmed exists. Its abstract claims a torsion-free word-hyperbolic group that is not residually finite, and the accompanying Lean file proves `∃ G, TorsionFree G ∧ WordHyperbolic G ∧ ¬ ResiduallyFinite G`. The result is unrefereed but machine-checked, modulo the stated gap between the two hyperbolicity definitions. The statement is faithful.
